summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser and its tests; nothing committed. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py (SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path) and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (41 passed). mypy, black, isort and flake8 are not installed in the shared venv, so type-ignore placement and import order were checked by reading only. Choices: an explicit Node isinstance guard (so None is not treated as a wildcard), and the optional-lookup type-ignore sits on the call line rather than the with line.
